title: Numerical Methods / Computation for Engineers
description: This syllabus blends numerical methods with engineering computation practice: students learn the algorithms, implement them in MATLAB/Python, verify numerical behavior, and communicate computational results as engineering evidence.

topics.title: Engineering Computation Workflow, Programming, and Reproducibility
topics.description: Introduce MATLAB/Python workflows, notebooks, scripts, functions, data structures, debugging, and reproducible computation.

children.title: Programming Environment and Workflow
children.description: Students learn the practical computational setup used for engineering analysis.

children.title: Script, function, notebook, command window, workspace, and package/library
MATLAB, Python, NumPy, SciPy, Jupyter, and plotting libraries
Input, output, parameter file, result file, and reproducible directory structure
Vectorization, loops, conditionals, arrays, matrices, and broadcasting
Code Quality and Debugging
children.description: The point is to make code that can be trusted and maintained.

children.title: Syntax error, runtime error, logic error, and numerical error
Breakpoint, print debugging, unit test, assertion, and sanity check
Function decomposition, meaningful variable names, comments, and docstrings
Version control, commit, branch, README, and computational notebook hygiene
Engineering Visualization and Reporting
children.description: Students learn to communicate computational results clearly.

children.title: Line plot, scatter plot, contour plot, surface plot, log plot, and residual plot
Axis label, units, legend, annotation, and figure caption
Table of parameters, assumptions, and computed outputs
Reproducible report, technical memo, and computational appendix

topics.title: Error Analysis, Floating-Point Arithmetic, and Numerical Stability
topics.description: Understand roundoff, truncation, conditioning, convergence, and stability in engineering calculations.

children.title: Floating-Point Arithmetic
children.description: Students learn why computers do not do exact real-number arithmetic.

children.title: Binary representation, floating-point number, mantissa, exponent, machine epsilon, and overflow/underflow
Roundoff error, chopping, rounding, and significant digits
Catastrophic cancellation and subtractive cancellation
Single precision, double precision, and complex numbers
Error Types and Propagation
children.description: This subtopic gives the vocabulary for estimating and controlling numerical error.

children.title: Absolute error, relative error, percent error, true error, and approximate error
Truncation error, discretization error, iteration error, and modeling error
Taylor series, order of accuracy, leading error term, and error constant
Error propagation, sensitivity coefficient, and uncertainty amplification
Conditioning, Stability, and Convergence
children.description: The goal is to distinguish problem sensitivity from algorithm behavior.

children.title: Condition number, ill-conditioned problem, well-conditioned problem, and sensitivity
Stable algorithm, unstable algorithm, backward error, and forward error
Convergence criterion, tolerance, residual, and stopping rule
Verification by refinement, benchmark comparison, and dimensional check

topics.title: Root Finding and Nonlinear Equation Solving
topics.description: Solve scalar and coupled nonlinear equations arising from engineering models.

children.title: Bracketing Methods
children.description: Students learn robust methods that locate roots using sign changes.

children.title: Root, residual, nonlinear equation, and bracket
Bisection method, false position method, and interval halving
Intermediate value theorem and sign-change condition
Absolute tolerance, relative tolerance, function tolerance, and iteration count
Open Methods
children.description: This subtopic covers faster methods that need better initial guesses.

children.title: Fixed-point iteration, Newton-Raphson method, secant method, and modified Newton method
Derivative, tangent approximation, convergence rate, and quadratic convergence
Divergence, oscillation, multiple root, and poor initial guess
Engineering examples: friction factor, nonlinear spring, heat balance, and equilibrium equation
Systems of Nonlinear Equations
children.description: Many engineering models require solving several nonlinear equations together.

children.title: Vector residual, Jacobian matrix, Newton method for systems, and finite-difference Jacobian
Damped Newton, line search, trust region, and convergence basin
Scaling variables, nondimensionalization, and residual normalization
Solver diagnostics, failed convergence, and physical feasibility checks

topics.title: Numerical Linear Algebra and Linear Systems
topics.description: Solve dense and sparse linear systems using direct and iterative methods.

children.title: Direct Linear Solvers
children.description: Students learn the core algorithms for Ax = b problems.

children.title: Linear system, coefficient matrix, right-hand side, and augmented matrix
Gaussian elimination, back substitution, forward substitution, and row operation
LU factorization, pivoting, permutation matrix, and triangular solve
Multiple right-hand sides and factorization reuse
Matrix Conditioning and Error
children.description: This subtopic teaches students to judge whether a linear solve is reliable.

children.title: Matrix norm, vector norm, residual norm, and relative residual
Condition number, ill-conditioning, rank deficiency, and nearly singular matrix
Scaling, pivot growth, and roundoff amplification
Engineering examples: stiffness matrices, circuit equations, and least-squares normal equations
Sparse and Iterative Solvers
children.description: The goal is to handle large engineering systems efficiently.

children.title: Sparse matrix, banded matrix, storage format, and fill-in
Jacobi method, Gauss-Seidel method, successive over-relaxation, and conjugate gradient
Preconditioner, convergence rate, and stopping tolerance
Finite difference/finite element systems and computational cost

topics.title: Curve Fitting, Regression, and Data-Driven Engineering Models
topics.description: Fit empirical models to engineering data and quantify residuals and uncertainty.

children.title: Least-Squares Fitting
children.description: Students learn how to fit models when data are noisy or overdetermined.

children.title: Residual, sum of squared errors, least-squares objective, and normal equations
Linear regression, polynomial regression, basis function, and design matrix
Overdetermined system, QR factorization, and numerical stability of fitting
Goodness of fit, R-squared, root mean square error, and residual plot
Nonlinear and Weighted Regression
children.description: This subtopic broadens fitting to realistic engineering models.

children.title: Nonlinear least squares, parameter estimate, initial guess, and solver convergence
Weighted least squares, heteroscedasticity, and measurement uncertainty
Confidence interval, prediction interval, and parameter correlation
Calibration curve, material model fitting, drag correlation, and heat-transfer correlation
Model Selection and Diagnostics
children.description: The point is to avoid fitting attractive but misleading models.

children.title: Underfitting, overfitting, extrapolation, interpolation, and validation data
Outlier, leverage, influence, and Cook's distance as diagnostic ideas
Cross-validation, train/test split, and residual structure
Physical interpretability and dimensional consistency

topics.title: Interpolation, Approximation, and Surrogate Models
topics.description: Approximate functions and data using interpolation, splines, and basis-function methods.

children.title: Polynomial Interpolation
children.description: Students learn exact-fit methods and their limitations.

children.title: Interpolation node, Lagrange polynomial, Newton divided difference, and interpolation error
Equally spaced points, Runge phenomenon, and Chebyshev nodes
Piecewise interpolation and local versus global approximation
Lookup tables, calibration data, and property tables
Splines and Piecewise Approximation
children.description: This subtopic gives stable tools for smooth engineering curves.

children.title: Linear spline, quadratic spline, cubic spline, knot, and continuity condition
Natural spline, clamped spline, and not-a-knot boundary condition
Shape preservation, monotonic interpolation, and smoothing spline
CAD curves, material property curves, and experimental response curves
Surrogate and Reduced Models
children.description: The goal is to approximate expensive simulations or experiments.

children.title: Response surface, metamodel, surrogate model, and emulator
Radial basis function, polynomial response surface, and Gaussian process preview
Design points, sampling plan, and validation error
Simulation acceleration, optimization support, and uncertainty screening

topics.title: Numerical Differentiation and Numerical Integration
topics.description: Approximate derivatives and integrals while understanding accuracy and error behavior.

children.title: Finite Difference Derivatives
children.description: Students learn to approximate derivatives from functions or data.

children.title: Forward difference, backward difference, central difference, and step size
First derivative, second derivative, truncation error, and roundoff trade-off
Richardson extrapolation and higher-order formula
Noisy data differentiation and smoothing caution
Newton-Cotes Integration
children.description: This subtopic covers common engineering quadrature formulas.

children.title: Trapezoidal rule, composite trapezoidal rule, Simpson's 1/3 rule, Simpson's 3/8 rule, and composite Simpson rule
Step size, panel, integration error, and order of accuracy
Unequally spaced data and tabulated-data integration
Work, impulse, heat transfer, area, and accumulated quantity examples
Adaptive and Gaussian Quadrature
children.description: The point is to integrate efficiently when functions vary unevenly.

children.title: Adaptive quadrature, error estimate, recursive subdivision, and tolerance
Gaussian quadrature, quadrature point, weight, and exactness degree
Improper integral, singular behavior, and oscillatory integrand caution
Numerical integration in SciPy/MATLAB and verification against known integrals

topics.title: Ordinary Differential Equation Initial-Value Solvers
topics.description: Solve dynamic engineering models with explicit and implicit ODE methods.

children.title: Explicit Single-Step Methods
children.description: Students learn time-marching methods for dynamic engineering systems.

children.title: Initial value problem, state variable, time step, and right-hand-side function
Forward Euler, midpoint method, Heun method, and fourth-order Runge-Kutta
Local truncation error, global error, and order of method
Mass-spring-damper, cooling, tank draining, and population/process examples
Adaptive and Implicit Methods
children.description: This subtopic introduces solver choices for difficult dynamics.

children.title: Adaptive time step, error control, embedded Runge-Kutta pair, and event detection
Backward Euler, trapezoidal method, implicit method, and nonlinear solve per step
Stiff ODE, stability region, and stiffness ratio
MATLAB ode45/ode15s and SciPy solve_ivp solver selection
Systems of ODEs and Model Validation
children.description: The goal is to translate engineering models into solver-ready form.

children.title: First-order system form, state vector, parameter vector, and input function
Conservation checks, invariants, and physical bounds
Step-size refinement study and analytical benchmark
Parameter sensitivity and numerical versus modeling error

topics.title: Boundary Value Problems and Eigenvalue Problems
topics.description: Solve engineering boundary-value and modal/eigenvalue problems numerically.

children.title: Boundary Value Problems
children.description: Students learn methods for problems specified at multiple locations.

children.title: Boundary value problem, Dirichlet condition, Neumann condition, and Robin condition
Shooting method, finite difference method, and collocation preview
Residual at boundary and root finding for missing initial condition
Beam deflection, heat conduction, and diffusion-reaction examples
Eigenvalue Problems
children.description: This subtopic supports vibrations, buckling, stability, and modal analysis.

children.title: Eigenvalue, eigenvector, matrix eigenproblem, and generalized eigenproblem
Power method, inverse iteration, QR algorithm as conceptual methods
Natural frequency, mode shape, buckling load, and stability threshold
Mode normalization and interpretation of numerical modes
Conditioning and Discretization Effects
children.description: The point is to understand how mesh and formulation influence results.

children.title: Grid spacing, mesh refinement, boundary approximation, and discretization matrix
Spurious mode, numerical dispersion, and truncation error
Convergence study and comparison to analytical solution
Ill-conditioned eigenproblem and scaling

topics.title: Finite Difference Methods for Partial Differential Equations
topics.description: Discretize steady and transient PDEs from heat transfer, diffusion, waves, and mechanics.

children.title: PDE Classification and Grids
children.description: Students learn how equation type influences numerical strategy.

children.title: Elliptic PDE, parabolic PDE, hyperbolic PDE, and conservation law
Grid, node, stencil, mesh spacing, time step, and computational domain
Initial condition, boundary condition, and source term
Heat equation, wave equation, Laplace equation, Poisson equation, and diffusion equation
Finite Difference Schemes
children.description: This subtopic develops practical discretization methods.

children.title: Forward-time central-space, backward-time central-space, Crank-Nicolson, and upwind scheme
Explicit scheme, implicit scheme, and semi-implicit idea
Stability, consistency, convergence, and Lax equivalence concept
CFL condition and time-step restriction
Engineering PDE Applications
children.description: The goal is to connect numerical schemes to real engineering models.

children.title: Transient heat conduction, steady heat conduction, diffusion, vibration/string wave, and potential flow examples
Boundary flux, insulated boundary, prescribed temperature, and convective boundary
Sparse matrix assembly and linear solve per time step
Visualization of fields, contours, and animated transients

topics.title: Optimization Methods for Engineering Design
topics.description: Use numerical optimization to improve designs subject to constraints.

children.title: Unconstrained Optimization
children.description: Students learn how numerical algorithms find minima and maxima.

children.title: Objective function, design variable, gradient, Hessian, and stationary point
Golden-section search, parabolic interpolation, steepest descent, and Newton method
Line search, trust region, and convergence criterion
Local minimum, global minimum, saddle point, and scaling
Constrained Optimization
children.description: This subtopic introduces realistic design constraints.

children.title: Equality constraint, inequality constraint, feasible region, active constraint, and Lagrange multiplier
Penalty method, barrier method, sequential quadratic programming, and KKT condition preview
Bound constraint, nonlinear constraint, and constraint violation
Weight, cost, stress, displacement, efficiency, and safety constraints
Engineering Design Optimization Practice
children.description: The point is to use optimization responsibly with models and uncertainty.

children.title: Sensitivity analysis, parametric sweep, and design space exploration
Multiobjective optimization, Pareto front, and weighted objective
Noisy objective, expensive simulation, and surrogate-assisted optimization
Verification of optimum and engineering feasibility

topics.title: Monte Carlo, Uncertainty Propagation, and Engineering Simulation
topics.description: Use random sampling and simulation to propagate uncertainty through engineering models.

children.title: Monte Carlo Sampling
children.description: Students learn to propagate uncertain inputs through computational models.

children.title: Random variable, input distribution, random seed, sample size, and replication
Monte Carlo estimate, sample mean, sample variance, and confidence interval
Latin hypercube sampling, stratified sampling, and variance reduction preview
Convergence rate and simulation standard error
Uncertainty Propagation
children.description: This subtopic connects numerical computation to engineering risk and design margins.

children.title: Parameter uncertainty, measurement uncertainty, model-form uncertainty, and numerical uncertainty
Sensitivity coefficient, tornado plot, and contribution to variance
Output distribution, percentile, exceedance probability, and reliability estimate
Uncertainty budget and propagation through nonlinear models
Simulation-Based Engineering Decisions
children.description: The goal is to summarize probabilistic results in a way that supports action.

children.title: Scenario analysis, risk metric, safety factor, and design margin
Failure probability, performance threshold, and robustness
Visualization: histogram, CDF, boxplot, and prediction band
Assumption documentation and limitations of simulation

topics.title: Verification, Validation, Testing, and Computational Ethics
topics.description: Build credible computational models through code testing, convergence checks, validation, and transparent reporting.

children.title: Code Verification and Testing
children.description: Students learn to check that the code solves the equations intended.

children.title: Unit test, regression test, integration test, and benchmark test
Manufactured solution, analytical solution, and conservation check
Grid convergence, time-step convergence, and observed order of accuracy
Debugging, assertion, exception handling, and automated test
Model Validation and Credibility
children.description: This subtopic addresses whether the model is adequate for the real system.

children.title: Validation data, calibration, prediction, and validation metric
Model-form error, parameter calibration, and uncertainty quantification
Verification versus validation versus uncertainty quantification
ASME V&V context and credibility assessment
Computational Ethics and Transparency
children.description: The point is to treat computational output as engineering evidence with responsibilities.

children.title: Reproducibility, traceability, versioning, and data/code availability
Assumption disclosure, limitation, conflict of interest, and uncertainty communication
Numerical result misuse, black-box model risk, and overconfidence
Responsible visualization and honest reporting

topics.title: Integrated Engineering Computation Project
topics.description: Synthesize numerical methods, programming, visualization, and engineering interpretation in a complete computation project.

children.title: Project Scoping and Model Selection
children.description: Students begin by defining a computational problem that is neither too vague nor too narrow.

children.title: Engineering question, objective, system boundary, assumptions, and success metric
Governing equation, empirical model, data source, and numerical method choice
Inputs, outputs, parameters, units, and constraints
Plan for verification, validation, and sensitivity analysis
Implementation and Analysis
children.description: This subtopic brings together coding, algorithms, and interpretation.

children.title: Modular code, reusable functions, notebook narrative, and version control
Solver implementation, library solver comparison, and benchmark case
Plots, tables, convergence study, and residual/error checks
Sensitivity study, uncertainty study, or optimization run
Technical Communication
children.description: The final deliverable asks students to make computational work understandable.

children.title: Executive summary, method, assumptions, results, discussion, and recommendation
Code appendix, reproducibility instructions, and data description
Limitations, uncertainty, validation evidence, and next steps
Oral presentation, figure quality, and engineering decision framing
